Dear Suntory Beverage & Food Europe team,

I'm writing to apply for the Corporate Communications Intern role. Your focus on storytelling across social media, website and campaigns — and the chance to see content reach real audiences — is exactly the kind of hands-on experience I'm looking for.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing work, I build and manage websites in WordPress, write SEO content, and use Canva for visuals. I've created structured data and llms.txt files to help content get found, and I regularly use AI tools to speed up research and drafting. I'm fluent in English, organised, and enjoy turning ideas into clear, engaging content.

I'd love to bring my curiosity and content skills to your External Affairs & Sustainability team and learn from experienced communicators across Europe.

Thank you for your consideration.

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm excited to apply for the Corporate Communications Intern position at Suntory Beverage & Food Europe. The opportunity to help tell the stories behind your brands, people and Growing for Good ambition — across social media, website, events and media — is exactly the kind of creative, hands-on communications work I want to do.

In my current roles as a freelance digital marketer and junior digital marketer at Episto, I build and manage websites in WordPress, write SEO content, and create visuals in Canva. I've designed and launched sites like baverok.com and mirook.com, where I implemented structured data, accessible markup and an llms.txt file to improve search visibility. I also manage CMS content for client sites, keeping pages fresh and on-brand, and I regularly use AI tools to support research and drafting. This experience has given me a strong eye for detail, an organised approach to managing multiple priorities, and a solid understanding of how digital content performs.

What draws me to Suntory is the emphasis on bringing fresh ideas and having space to learn by doing. I'm curious and proactive, and I enjoy finding the story behind the story — whether that's through a short-form video, a newsletter or a well-crafted social post. I'm fluent in English and comfortable collaborating with international teams, and I'm eager to contribute my content and digital skills while learning from experienced communications professionals.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how my background in digital content and SEO can support your External Affairs & Sustainability team. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

cv_highlights:
• Content creation and CMS management: writing and publishing SEO blog content, managing WordPress sites (Elementor, Astra, Rank Math), and creating visuals in Canva.
• Social media and digital understanding: experience with website content, social media integration, and using analytics (Google Analytics, Search Console) to track performance.
• Copywriting and editing: drafting and editing website content, blog posts, newsletters and presentations with a strong eye for detail.
• Organised and proactive: managing multiple client projects and priorities in a remote team, with a willingness to learn and experiment.
• Fluent English and international collaboration: native Turkish, fluent English, and experience working with teams and clients across Europe.
